response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), all_statuses AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_scan_count, AVG(sr.rate - a.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN all_statuses AS a WHERE sr.rate > a.average_rate

assumptions.assumption: The number of scans means the number of matched rows in scans; a zero duration has no defined rate and is ignored.

alternatives.interpretation: The number of scans means the sum of scancount, which records how many scans are in each set.
alternatives.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, SUM(sc.scancount) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), all_statuses AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_scan_count, AVG(sr.rate - a.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN all_statuses AS a WHERE sr.rate > a.average_rate
